description: Dialogue evaluation of the ReLU.chat inference layer in keyword-matching mode (no MiniLM download). Questions were written by separate models from topic lists, not taken from the knowledge text. The figures measure topic routing, honesty about coverage, cross-assistant routing and reference resolution; they do not measure the factual accuracy of the curated text. "previous" is the pipeline this layer replaced, run on the same questions.

metrics.knownFalseAbstain: Covered topic refused ("I don't have notes…") — lower is better
metrics.offTopic: Everyday question given no topic answer
metrics.crossBot: Routed to the assistant that covers it
metrics.crossBotHonest: Other-assistant question not answered as if covered
metrics.wh: Who/when/where/how-many: evidence shown, or absence stated
metrics.turns: Multi-turn expectations met (pronouns, ellipsis, social turns, unknowns)

dialogue-eval.about: Development set: written by a separate model from the topic lists before the layer was built, then used to find and fix failures.

firstRun.note: Blind first run on 2026-10-22, before any change prompted by this set (percentages).

dialogue-test.about: Held-out set in casual chat style (typos, slang). Its first run was recorded before any change; afterwards it was used to diagnose general failure causes, so the current figures are no longer blind.

firstRun.note: Blind single scoring on 2026-10-22 after the layer was frozen (percentages). Its three refusals all came from short follow-up requests in the same message ("Convince me.") being judged as separate questions; that defect was then fixed, so the overall figures below are a re-run and no longer blind.

dialogue-final.about: Final set written after the layer was frozen, in three voices (exam student, skeptical expert, beginner). Scored once; never used for tuning.
